args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A few bullets on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- The acronym PHL is shared with Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filtering on PHL returns both accounts.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". Its label should read Pellow Home Living, since the old name is making searches run twice.
- Could you confirm the current name to use in the deal desk records and whether the saved report label can be updated?

Thanks,
Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few bullets on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- The acronym PHL is shared by two accounts. Pellow Home Living is the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. Pellucid Harbor Logistics is the Gulf Coast terminal rows. Filtering on PHL returns both, so use the full names.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should be relabelled Pellow Home Living, since the old name makes searches run twice.
- Could you confirm the current name to use in deal desk records and whether the saved report label can be updated?

Thanks,
Sofia
